ctx.x: No, I never thought about getting together with them and having my picture taken, and this-that-and-the-other. The nearest I come to anything like that, I worked the Palace Theatre...oh, this is way back in the Thirties. Edward G. Robinson was on the bill and Kate Smith was on the bill, and Bessie Love -- Bessie Love was a movie star. Well, Edward G. Robinson at that time, he was just starting in pictures. He was a big man, he was a big star. So I went to Edward G. Robinson in his dressing room, and I asked him…

But I mean, I had never did anything like that! And all down through my career I never did it no more. I got Edward G. Robinson's and Bessie Love's -- Kate Smith didn't have any photographs of herself. I didn't get none of her anyway, and I worked with her twice. I didn't ask her for one the second time. But Bessie Love I got. And I got 'em,
